desc:
Tennessee Roleplay Community is a realistic statewide roleplay experience built for console and friends.

Choose your path:
🚔 State Trooper, Sheriff, Police & SWAT
🚒 Fire / EMS
🚛 Trucking & Jobs
🏙️ Civilian Life
🎙️ Voice Radio Communication

Experience pursuits, emergency response, robberies, trucking deliveries, farming, and immersive roleplay systems across Tennessee inspired locations.

Regular updates. Realistic gameplay. Endless scenarios.
